The migration is complete. The manager said, "Ready to launch." We still need to check the backups.

On Tuesday, I helped deploy the cache to two servers. In a 30-minute test, median latency for repeated requests fell from 80 ms to 60 ms. We have not yet tested cold starts or the remaining eight servers. This may reduce support tickets, though the dashboard still shows yesterday's data.
